content: KMC defaults are NOT exact-u32 counting and will break a naive parity gate vs rustkmer: -ci default 2 excludes singleton k-mers (official kmc_CLI/kmc.cpp usage text + README example), -cs default 255 caps counters (KMC issue #136: default 255, counts clip at -cs; counter width scales with -cs, so raising it changes KMC memory/speed), -cx default 1e9 excludes ultra-frequent k-mers (kmc.cpp usage), -m default 12 GB RAM, -sm strict-memory mode off by default, -t defaults to core count. A fair exact-count comparison (BENCH-V2-01) must run KMC with -ci1 -cx<u32max> -cs<u32max> and matched threads, and record that config honestly since u32 counters change KMC's performance profile. Re-verify defaults via kmc help at benchmark time.
